parameters.help_en: The CA certificate identifier. This parameter is optional for Dedicated with HTTPS. This parameter is not allowed for Serverless and is not validated for Dedicated with HTTP
parameters.help_zh: CA证书标识（Dedicated+HTTPS 可选；Serverless 禁止；Dedicated+HTTP 不校验）
parameters.name: ca_cert_identifier

parameters.help_en: The certificate identifier. This parameter is required for Dedicated with HTTPS and must pass validation. This parameter is not allowed for Serverless and is not validated for Dedicated with HTTP
parameters.help_zh: 证书标识（Dedicated+HTTPS 必填，需通过可提交校验；Serverless 禁止；Dedicated+HTTP 不校验）
parameters.name: cert_identifier

parameters.help_en: The client CA certificate. This parameter is conditionally required for Dedicated with HTTPS (required when MTLSEnabled is set to true). This parameter is not allowed for Serverless and is not validated for Dedicated with HTTP
parameters.help_zh: 客户端CA证书（Dedicated+HTTPS 条件必填（MTLSEnabled=true 时）；Serverless 禁止；Dedicated+HTTP 不校验）
parameters.name: client_ca_cert

parameters.help_en: The domain scope. Valid values: Dedicated (dedicated gateway domain name), Serverless (Serverless gateway domain name). Default value: Dedicated
parameters.help_zh: 域名作用域。取值：Dedicated（专享网关域名）、Serverless（Serverless 网关域名）。默认值：Dedicated
parameters.name: domain_scope

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable forced HTTPS redirect when the protocol type is HTTPS. This parameter is required for Serverless and for Dedicated with HTTPS. This parameter is not validated for Dedicated with HTTP
parameters.help_zh: 设置HTTPS协议类型，是否开启强制HTTPS跳转（Serverless 必填；Dedicated+HTTPS 必填；Dedicated+HTTP 不校验）
parameters.name: force_https

parameters.help_en: The gateway type. If not specified, the default value is API
parameters.help_zh: 网关类型（可选；不传默认 API）
parameters.name: gateway_type

parameters.help_en: The HTTP/2 setting. Valid values: GlobalConfig (follows the global configuration), Open (enabled), Close (disabled). Default value: GlobalConfig. This setting is supported only for HTTPS domain names in the Dedicated scope
parameters.help_zh: HTTP/2 设置。取值：GlobalConfig（跟随全局配置）、Open（开启）、Close（关闭）。默认值：GlobalConfig。仅 Dedicated 作用域的 HTTPS 域名支持该设置
parameters.name: http2_option

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable mTLS mutual authentication. This parameter is optional for Dedicated with HTTPS. If set to true, ClientCACert is required. This parameter is not allowed for Serverless
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启mTLS双向认证（Dedicated+HTTPS 可选；为 true 时 ClientCACert 必填；Serverless 禁止）
parameters.name: mtls_enabled

parameters.help_en: The domain name. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, such as abc.com
parameters.help_zh: 域名名称，长度为 1～128 个字符，例如 abc.com
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The protocol type used by the domain name. Valid values: HTTP, HTTPS. This parameter is required for the Dedicated scope and is not allowed for the Serverless scope
parameters.help_zh: 域名使用的协议类型。取值：HTTP、HTTPS。Dedicated 作用域必须设置，Serverless 作用域不允许设置
parameters.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The TLS cipher suite name, such as ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
fields.help_zh: TLS 加密套件名称，例如 ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
fields.name: name

parameters.help_en: The TLS cipher suite configuration, including the configuration type, cipher suite names, and supported TLS versions. This configuration is supported only for HTTPS domain names in the Dedicated scope
parameters.help_zh: TLS 加密套件配置，包含配置类型、加密套件名称和支持的 TLS 版本。仅 Dedicated 作用域的 HTTPS 域名支持该配置
parameters.name: tls_cipher_suites_config

parameters.help_en: The maximum TLS protocol version. This parameter is optional for Dedicated with HTTPS. If not specified, the value is derived from TlsMin. The value must be greater than or equal to TlsMin. This parameter is not allowed for Serverless
parameters.help_zh: TLS协议最大版本（Dedicated+HTTPS 可选，不传按 TlsMin 推导，需≥TlsMin；Serverless 禁止）
parameters.name: tls_max

parameters.help_en: The minimum TLS protocol version. This parameter is optional for Dedicated with HTTPS. If not specified, the default value is TLS 1.0. Valid values range from TLS 1.0 to TLS 1.3, compatible with TLSv1.x. This parameter is not allowed for Serverless
parameters.help_zh: TLS协议最小版本（Dedicated+HTTPS 可选，不传默认 TLS 1.0，允许 TLS 1.0~1.3 兼容 TLSv1.x；Serverless 禁止）
parameters.name: tls_min

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token generated by the caller as a globally unique value (UUID recommended). The value must be up to 64 characters in length. Within approximately 24 hours after the first successful request, a duplicate request with the same ClientToken and identical request parameters directly returns the domainId created by the first request without creating a duplicate domain name. If the same ClientToken is used with different request parameters, an IdempotentParameterMismatch error is returned. If the first request is still being processed, an IdempotentProcessing error is returned. If this parameter is not specified, idempotency control is not enabled, and the behavior is consistent with the existing version
parameters.help_zh: 幂等标识，由调用方生成全局唯一值（推荐 UUID），长度不超过 64 个字符。首次请求成功后约 24 小时内，携带相同 ClientToken 且请求参数一致的重复请求直接返回首次创建的 domainId，不重复创建域名；携带相同 ClientToken 但请求参数不一致时返回 IdempotentParameterMismatch；首次请求仍在处理中时返回 IdempotentProcessing；缺省时不启用幂等控制，行为与现有版本一致
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. If set to true, all synchronous validations consistent with actual creation are performed (including idempotency checks for existing test domain names), but no domain name is created and no side effects are produced. If not specified or set to false, the behavior is consistent with the existing version
parameters.help_zh: 是否只做预检校验（dry run）。true 时执行与真实创建一致的全部同步校验（含既有测试域名的幂等判定）但不创建域名、不产生任何副作用；缺省或 false 时行为与现有版本一致
parameters.name: dry_run

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to trace the API call chain
requestId.description_zh: 请求id，用于追溯API调用链路
